translations.web: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
translations.bsb: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’
translations.kjv: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
